performance.evidence: One supervised process polls Liquidsoap every 2000 ms and enriches only on path changes; listeners receive PubSub without per-listener provider calls.

reliability.evidence: Tests prove unchanged paths are not republished, ended paths clear once, control/provider failures preserve the last valid track, and browser/HLS failures expose reconnection without a refresh.

operability.evidence: now_playing_changed and now_playing_poll_failed logs expose transitions and bounded failures without credentials.

integration.listener_message: Slack text is bounded to 280 characters, persisted, HEEx-escaped, and omitted for link-only messages
integration.local_volume: Native range control changes only HTMLAudioElement.volume without reconnecting HLS
